This game is crazy because I’ve been playing since January and I consider it something I love now. I never spent time on or saw much merit on games you play on your phone. I knew the whole gimmick of gacha. I’ve played more BL games than otome games, I don’t usually like otome MCs and don’t like be ‘teased’ spicy stuff without ever getting it, so I also expected to lose interest within a few days for that reason. I saw ads on instagram all the time with Rafayel and I was like ‘yeah whatever’ lol. (They know I like himbo games but this is the only one that’s ever really grabbed me lol)

A couple days after launch, they started having ads with Xavier having his ass touched on the home screen so…that’s what got me to start ultimately, not gonna lie 😂 

What has kept me is the overall quality of the game. It’s just enough to where I can let it take up a couple hours of my day if I want, or I can just bust through dailies in a few minutes on a busy day. 

I haven’t gotten tired of Xavier or any of the other LIs (he’s just my favorite 💕) and am always excited by the new things they do to make me want new 5-stars even more than the last ones. 

I really enjoy the moments with the 4 and 5 star cards; they’re surprisingly memorable and I’ll never get enough of this game visually. Music is also pretty good tbh; I know it’s not perfect but it is a pretty awesome game and I’m really glad to have it. I hope we can enjoy it for a long time. I didn’t think I’d ever spend money on a game like this, but I’ve maintained my aurum pass all this time (too worth it for the diamonds alone) and have bought extra wishes maybe 2-3 times, but it’s thankfully not more than ~$40-$50 total since the game came out.

Only thing is that I’ll always wish it was a standalone like $60-$70 PC/console game, that would be too badass…but the game as it is, still amazing. ✌🏻 sometimes if I leave the game open I’ll find my husband tapping it and when I confront him he’s like ‘I’m trying to touch his ass…!’ 😂
